maddeler.e:
نتفاوض (form VI)
# نَتَفَاوَضُ (natafāwaḍu) /na.ta.faː.wa.dˤu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَفَاوَضَ (tafāwaḍa)
# نَتَفَاوَضَ (natafāwaḍa) /na.ta.faː.wa.dˤa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَفَاوَضَ (tafāwaḍa)
# نَتَفَاوَضْ (natafāwaḍ) /na.ta.faː.wadˤ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَفَاوَضَ (tafāwaḍa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
